Name: FE_TEXT_EFFECT_PARAM_ST
Description: Large on-screen banners such as "YOU DIED", "GREAT ENEMY FELLED" or "LOST GRACE DISCOVERED". The row ID is the banner ID requested by events and the game.

Fields.Name: Layout ID
Fields.Description: Menu layout used for the banner: element TextEffect_<value> of the banner screen, which sets its look and animation. Several rows can share one (retail: 30 for the ten Furled Finger rank-up banners).

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text shown in the banner, from the menu text. -1: no text.

Fields.Name: Sound ID
Fields.Description: Sound played with the banner (category m). 0 or less: none.

Fields.Name: Display Simultaneously with Map Name
Fields.Description: When a map name banner is waiting to be shown, it is shown together with this banner (and no longer waits). Off: the banner is shown alone. Retail: only on LOST GRACE DISCOVERED.
